description: Domain intelligence: WHOIS/RDAP registration (registrar, created and expiry dates, status, name servers) plus DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CAA) and email security (SPF, DMARC), with flags for new, expiring or misconfigured domains, as one JSON object.
